answer.reason: Several verses say something of the city beyond listing it: its gift to the Kohathites, the Philistine pursuit that ended there, and its capture by the Philistines.

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the children of Kohath
clauses.quote: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs

clauses.english: marked the end of the slaughter of the Philistines that began at Michmash
clauses.quote: they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon

clauses.english: was taken by the Philistines, who dwelt there
clauses.quote: had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth

doubts: JOS 19:42, 2CH 11:10 and 1CH 6:69 only list the city, so they were not used.
JDG 1:35 (Amorites dwelling in Aijalon) and 1CH 8:13 (heads of the fathers of its inhabitants) were left out as minor.
JOS 21:24 places the city under Dan, but the Kohathite link rests on JOS 21:26 as context.
